name: DVOL-spike IV capitulation reversion — buy crypto into a crypto-native implied-vol panic
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (the CONTRARIAN mirror of dvol-calm-regime-momentum, which trades trend in LOW dvol; this trades reversion out of HIGH dvol, and is crypto-NATIVE unlike macro-vix-spike-capitulation): Deribit DVOL is the BTC/ETH options market's 30-day implied vol — the crypto VIX. A DVOL spike means options dealers are pricing extreme fear and demanding a fat volatility premium; historically these IV panics mark the point of maximum forced deleveraging, after which realized vol mean-reverts below implied and spot snaps back (the documented short-vol / post-spike reversion premium). Crucially DVOL is read from the OPTIONS market, an orthogonal panic gauge to spot drawdown, funding, or liquidation prints. Entry: dvol above a fitted panic floor AND price not in freefall (trend floor = knife guard). Exit: dvol crosses DOWN through a calm threshold (IV premium decayed, reversion played out) or stop/TP/time. Disconfirmer 1: if an unconditional dip-buy matches the deflated Sharpe, the DVOL extreme adds nothing. Disconfirmer 2: DVOL spikes co-occur with VIX spikes and fear_greed lows; if substituting vix_level or fear_greed does as well this carries no orthogonal CRYPTO-OPTIONS information. Disconfirmer 3 (data depth): only ~148 DVOL points — low-confidence, paper-only until the series deepens. Disconfirmer 4 (cost): the bounce must clear ~20bps round-trip net. tier0 crypto-native vol feature.
